questions.q: What was the name of Beauty's new groom?
Beauty calls Alfred Smirk a "humbug." What does "humbug" mean here?
choices: A person who pretends to be better than he is
A person who hums while he works
questions.evidence: if ever there was a humbug in the shape of a groom

questions.q: When did Alfred do a great deal of stroking and patting?
choices: When his master was there to see it
questions.evidence: he did a great deal of stroking and patting when his master was there to see it

questions.q: What did Alfred spend a great deal of time on in the harness-room?
questions.evidence: he spent a great deal of time about his hair, whiskers and necktie

questions.q: What was the real cause of the bad smell in Beauty's box?
choices: Alfred never took all the old straw away
A dead rat under the floor
questions.evidence: He never took all the straw away

questions.q: What happened when the bricklayer came to check the drains?
choices: He found nothing wrong but charged five shillings
He found a broken drain and fixed it
He told Mr. Barry to fire Alfred
questions.evidence: found nothing amiss; so he put down some lime and charged the master five shillings

questions.q: What did the farrier say was wrong with Beauty's feet?
choices: He had a stone in his shoe
questions.evidence: Your horse has got the 'thrush', and badly, too

questions.q: Why did Mr. Barry decide to give up keeping a horse?
choices: He was disgusted at being fooled by two grooms in a row
He could not afford the food
His doctor told him to stop riding
questions.evidence: Mr. Barry was so much disgusted at being twice deceived by his grooms
